purpose: Controlled long-context retention audit using official-code-generated RULER NIAH data, paired with the same KiaOmni percentage budgets and verified actual MoE routing.

data.mirror_revision: resolved and frozen into the Modal asset index at prepare time
data.answer_prefix_policy: Reattach stored answer_prefix to input before applying the Qwen chat template.

suite.selection: Five deterministic target-answer depth strata per task/length, nearest unused sample to 10/30/50/70/90 percent, preferring its corresponding 20-point bin.

scoring.official_compatible_primary: RULER NIAH string_match_all semantics: fraction of required gold outputs found as case-insensitive substrings of prediction.
scoring.ppl: Teacher-forced PPL over a deterministic canonical join of required outputs; diagnostic, not the official RULER score.

claim_boundary: This remains prompt-side pruning, not runtime past_key_values eviction.
RULER is a controlled retention benchmark and is reported separately from LongBench-v2 reasoning stress results.
Percentage-budget RULER results do not replace the frozen fixed-budget LongBench evidence.
Needle-survival metrics diagnose whether required evidence survived selection; answer accuracy can still fail after evidence survives.
